meta.title: feat: enable WAL mode for SQLite
meta.body_summary: Enable SQLite WAL mode via pragma to reduce database locking, with a unit test verifying the setting.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI Codex added a single pragma to enable WAL mode with a unit test; only bot nitpicks, no blocking review; merged after a month with no human performance evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: The total changed lines are large (8595) due to an unrelated merge from main, but the core performance change is tiny (about 5 lines in src/database/index.ts to set journal_mode=WAL and a small test file). Despite the inflated line count, the actual change is minimal, consistent with a small-step performance PR that merged without objections.

review_details.concern_detail: Bots suggested TypeScript type improvements, logging WAL failures, and Node.js import protocol; none blocked the merge.
review_details.performance_claim: Enables SQLite WAL mode to reduce database locking.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: A single pragma change to enable WAL mode is well within agent capability; the long merge delay and bot-only review reflect process rather than technical barrier.

detection_detail.code_reading: No human code review detected; bots performed static analysis.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR includes a unit test that verifies WAL mode is set, but no before/after performance measurement or workload evidence for locking reduction.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regressions; bot suggestions were not implemented but non-blocking.

core_change_summary.description: In src/database/index.ts, getDb() now sets journal_mode = WAL via sqliteInstance.pragma, with errors silently carried; added closeDb() to clean up connections; new test/database/index.test.ts verifies WAL mode and connection closure.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The vast majority of changed files (192/197) come from merging main and are unrelated to the WAL change; they include docs, examples, and configuration.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: enable WAL mode and add a basic test (80bc76e).
Bot added unit test for index.ts (e667300).
Merged main branch, causing large diff.

review_signals.summary: Suggested correcting Database.Database to InstanceType<typeof Database> for stronger typing.
Recommended logging WAL pragma failures instead of silently catching.
Posted review summary with nitpick suggestions and walkthrough.

No test execution environment matched for the commit.
TestGru assigned a unit test task and reported a finished test.

collaboration_trajectory: Author opened PR with a small WAL change and a basic test.
After 23 days, multiple bots reviewed and left non-blocking nitpick comments and a bug report.
A bot added a separate unit test file.
Author merged main branch (introducing a large diff) and applied linting updates.
